purpose: Bounded closed-loop tracker shadow on unchanged baseline detector inputs; no production promotion or end-to-end learning claim.
selection: Previously exposed 0029 encounter windows,0126 known gap plus all seven original workload-control intervals,0055 fixed frame grid. Query all eligible shadow tracks over the full frame in scheduled intervals, not annotation-centered ROIs. Familiar development sampling; not blind or negative-labeled evaluation.
detector_inputs: Independent unchanged v29 combined full-file replays from frame0, serial_reference policy. Baseline alone determines detector learning. Clean/shadow baseline outputs,private states and learning inputs must match exactly.

shadow.initialization: Independent ordinary VisibleTracks from frame0; own strong associations,births,counters and expiry. Never teacher-force baseline assignments or posteriors.
shadow.eligibility: Prior strong-qualified existing track left unmatched by shadow strong pass, alive within unchanged last-strong coast deadline.
shadow.noise_interpretation: Provisional hypothesis fixed before new outcomes, not empirical raw-peak calibration or identity confidence.
shadow.query: Inherited45px AND Mahalanobis-squared25 gate using Pprior+Rstrong, unchanged spatial3sigma, raw-absolute5x5 maxima, positive same-polarity centered temporal response below original4sigma threshold.
shadow.acceptance: Exactly one observed peak total, weak only, complete support and neighborhood coverage, zero other same-polarity prior-owner gates. Veto overlap with any current strong shape support or centroid within max(2px,existing NMS radius).
shadow.weak_changes: Own mean and covariance only, Joseph update with2*Rstrong. Separate weak_evidence output; measured stays strong-only.
shadow.expiry: Original strong-only missed-window deletion plus elapsed coast_seconds since last strong observation; weak never rearms expiry or revives a deleted track.
shadow.outside_windows: Ordinary independent strong tracking continues; weak updates disabled. Counterfactual state is never reset to baseline.

capture.bridge: Reuse separately frozen V56 read-only native bridge; unchanged production library.
capture.resource_policy: Abort the run on excess resource bound, never select top-k tracks or silently discard coverage. Missing/out-of-frame coverage explicitly abstains.
capture.archive: Persist complete detached snapshots actually requested by unmatched shadow tracks; keep all prior forecasts,strong proposals,decisions and capture geometry. Release all frame snapshots after the shadow step.
capture.baseline_state_hash_guard: Hash full exposed native state before and after capture batch. Verify baseline private state and actual learning-input equality against clean arm.

required_tests: Independent future strong reassociation after weak update
No weak births or hit/learning credit
One weak correction per strong gap
Identical true-point and disappeared-target-plus-decoy observations receive identical decisions, with false correction honestly reported
evaluation: Separate strong measurement,weak correction and prediction counts; compare strong-association changes,qualified track workload,lifetimes and fixed historical references. Preserve ambiguous/absent assignments. Unlabeled control workload is not a false-positive rate. No promotion from recovering frame216 alone.
cost: Record capture/query/shadow overhead separately. Instrumented replay FPS is not production FPS or live latency.
presentation_baseline: Unchanged v29 with v34 verified validation.
